transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'd like to get our pre-approval review scheduled for the live podcast recording draft plan. As a reminder, the plan currently includes live audience microphones, video recording, a 90-minute session, and an unassigned accessible seating area for the Harbor Room on October 18. Before I issue anything to the venue and production crew, I need the stage manager, rights coordinator, and accessibility coordinator to review it with me. Could we coordinate a time to go through the draft together?
